description: The University of Virginia Biocomplexity team publishes a coarse synthetic population for Italy in the Synthetic Populations for Regions of the World series. Zenodo lists a public ZIP and a README under CC BY 4.0. The README documents person, household, residence, activity-location and person-to-location assignment CSVs, plus a separate contact matrix and validation plots. It identifies World Bank activity templates, IPUMS households, GPW population counts and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest as inputs. The data can supply agents and plausible daily activity destinations for national transport-access or emergency-service simulation scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Italy release. A limitation is that the synthesis was developed for interaction and epidemic modelling; it is not an observed census of individual trips or infrastructure demand. The README labels it a coarse version 0.9.0 and does not establish fine-scale road-network routing accuracy. The ZIP was not downloaded, so row counts, geometry and upstream reuse conditions were not independently checked.
